about: The sky of Imbar: twelve constellations, one rising in each month of the year of the Sun and Moon (src/campaign/calendar.ts), under which a life is said to be born. Each has its name, the month it rules, a line of what folk who read the sky say of those born under it, and its stars, each a point on a unit field (x right, y down) with a brightness from 1 to 3, joined in order by its lines, for a page to draw. What a sign means in play is the world's to say (see CreationFlow): those who read the sky may read it in you. Orsino's signs were a zodiac animal and an element; Imbar's are its own months.

signs.name: the Waking Bear
signs.line: Slow to rise, and not to be turned once risen.

signs.name: the Sower
signs.line: What they put by in the dark comes up in its time.

signs.name: the Hart
signs.line: Quick, wary, and lovely when it is not looking.

signs.name: the Lantern
signs.line: Others find their way by them, and seldom say so.

signs.name: the Crown
signs.line: They are listened to before they have said anything worth it.

signs.name: the Scythe
signs.line: They finish what others leave standing.

signs.name: the Sheaf
signs.line: Open-handed, and the hand is usually full.

signs.name: the Fox
signs.line: Never where they were looked for, and always where they meant to be.

signs.name: the Hearth
signs.line: Where they sit, people gather and stay.

signs.name: the Swan
signs.line: Calm on the water, and nobody sees the work beneath it.

signs.name: the Ship
signs.line: Restless in harbour, and bound to go out again.

signs.name: the Wolf
signs.line: They keep faith with their own, and with no one else.
